title: The Final Plague Announced

questions.question: What did God tell Moses would be the final plague on Egypt?
questions.explanation: Exodus 11:5 (ESV): "Every firstborn in the land of Egypt shall die."

questions.question: At what time did Moses say the Lord would strike Egypt?
questions.explanation: Exodus 11:4 (ESV): "Thus says the Lord: About midnight I will go out in the midst of Egypt."

questions.question: What did God say Pharaoh would do after this final plague?
questions.explanation: Exodus 11:1 (ESV): "Afterward he will let you go from here. When he lets you go, he will drive you away completely."

questions.question: What did God tell the Israelites to ask from their Egyptian neighbors?
questions.explanation: Exodus 11:2 (ESV): "Let every man ask of his neighbor... for silver and gold jewelry."

questions.question: Whose firstborn would be struck - from highest to lowest?
options: From Pharaoh to the slave girl behind the handmill
questions.correctAnswer: From Pharaoh to the slave girl behind the handmill
questions.explanation: Exodus 11:5 (ESV): "From the firstborn of Pharaoh who sits on his throne, even to the firstborn of the slave girl who is behind the handmill."

questions.question: How did the Lord make the Egyptians view the Israelites?
questions.explanation: Exodus 11:3 (ESV): "The Lord gave the people favor in the sight of the Egyptians."

questions.question: How did Moses leave Pharaoh after announcing the final plague?
questions.explanation: Exodus 11:8 (ESV): "And he went out from Pharaoh in hot anger."

questions.question: What contrast did God make between Egypt and Israel during the final plague?
options: Israel would sleep while Egypt mourned
Not a dog would growl against Israel, showing God's distinction
Israel would feast while Egypt starved
questions.correctAnswer: Not a dog would growl against Israel, showing God's distinction
questions.explanation: Exodus 11:7 (ESV): "But not a dog shall growl against any of the people of Israel... that you may know that the Lord makes a distinction."

questions.question: What did Moses say Pharaoh's servants would do after the final plague?
options: Bow down to Moses and beg Israel to leave
questions.correctAnswer: Bow down to Moses and beg Israel to leave
questions.explanation: Exodus 11:8 (ESV): "All these your servants shall come down to me and bow down to me, saying, 'Get out, you and all the people who follow you.'"

questions.question: How was Moses regarded in the land of Egypt?
questions.explanation: Exodus 11:3 (ESV): "Moreover, the man Moses was very great in the land of Egypt."

questions.question: According to Exodus 11:9, why did God allow Pharaoh to refuse to listen?
options: So that God's wonders might be multiplied in Egypt
questions.correctAnswer: So that God's wonders might be multiplied in Egypt
questions.explanation: Exodus 11:9 (ESV): "Pharaoh will not listen to you, that my wonders may be multiplied in the land of Egypt."

questions.question: Besides humans, what else would lose their firstborn?
options: All the firstborn of the cattle
questions.correctAnswer: All the firstborn of the cattle
questions.explanation: Exodus 11:5 (ESV): "And all the firstborn of the cattle."

questions.question: What cry would go up throughout Egypt that night?
options: A great cry such as there has never been nor ever will be again
questions.correctAnswer: A great cry such as there has never been nor ever will be again
questions.explanation: Exodus 11:6 (ESV): "There shall be a great cry throughout all the land of Egypt, such as there has never been, nor ever will be again."

questions.question: What did Exodus 11:10 reveal about Moses and Aaron's actions before Pharaoh?
options: They did all these wonders before Pharaoh
questions.correctAnswer: They did all these wonders before Pharaoh
questions.explanation: Exodus 11:10 (ESV): "Moses and Aaron did all these wonders before Pharaoh."

questions.question: This chapter describes how many more plagues God would bring?
questions.explanation: Exodus 11:1 (ESV): "Yet one plague more I will bring upon Pharaoh and upon Egypt."

key_verse_text: And every firstborn in the land of Egypt shall die, from the firstborn of Pharaoh who sits on his throne, even to the firstborn of the slave girl who is behind the handmill, and all the firstborn of the cattle.
